title: Knowledge Digester 3: recognising what an artifact is
requested_outcome: Context: the Knowledge Digester (product memory SOURCE_ASSIMILATION_V1.md, NEXT_PHASE_2026-09-25.md section 2, and the owner's direction of 2026-09-26) is how CLIVE takes in any kind of external artifact - git repositories, agent skills, documents, API and tool specifications, datasets, web apps and themes, media, eventually any application or file - and turns it into provenance-tagged, reversible knowledge and capability. It lives in a new package, crooks-assistant/app/digest/, standard library only (no new dependencies), with no network access and no execution of anything it reads: digesting is reading. Build app/digest/detect.py: detect_kinds(root) returns every kind a quarantined directory or file is, ranked by confidence, each with the evidence (paths and the signal found), reading only file names and small file heads, never executing anything. Kinds, as an extensible registry of small recognisers so new kinds can be added without editing the others: git repository; agent skill (SKILL.md with front matter) and skill collection; agent or harness configuration (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursor rules, prompt libraries); MCP server; OpenAPI or Swagger specification; JSON Schema set; GraphQL schema; Python package; Node package; Swift or Xcode project; Go, Rust and Java projects; Shopify theme; static website or web app; browser extension; mobile app project; Jupyter notebooks; documentation set; office documents (docx, xlsx, pptx, pdf); datasets (csv, tsv, jsonl, parquet, sqlite); design tokens and style systems (tokens.json, tailwind configuration, CSS custom properties); images, audio and video; container and infrastructure definitions (Dockerfile, compose, systemd units, Terraform); CI workflows; and 'unknown' with the file-type census when nothing matches. Also return a census (counts by extension and top-level layout) that later stages can use. Tests in tests/test_digest_detect.py build a fixture for every kind in tmp_path, check a multi-kind repository (for example a Python package that is also a skill collection with CI workflows) is reported with all its kinds, check ranking and evidence, and check that a new recogniser can be registered and is used. Do not create crooks-assistant/app/digest/__init__.py: a sibling objective creates the package initialiser, and until then app.digest imports as a namespace package, so tests import the module directly (from app.digest import detect). You cannot run commands: the loop runs the listed checks after you report and returns any failure output, and the independent review returns its findings, to your next attempt. Do not report an owner decision for GitHub acceptance: it runs automatically after your candidate is published.
acceptance_criteria: detect_kinds reports every listed kind with evidence and confidence, including several kinds at once
nothing is executed and only names and small heads are read
every listed check passes in the worker's workspace
